newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana Stock Exchange firms slightly, volume higher.
newsitem.headline: Ghana Stock Exchange firms slightly, volume higher.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange firmed slightly on Monday and trading volume rose, but offers continued to outstrip demand, its market report showed.
The GSE All-Share Index rose 0.55 points to 383.51 points from 382.96 points on Friday.

A total of 1.27 million shares changed hands compared with Friday's 14,670 shares and Wednesday's equally modest 15,370. A block trade in Mechanical Lloyd Co shares accounted for 1.2 million of the shares trade on Monday.
Offers outstripped bids by 2.31 million to 1.38 million. Friday's split was 1,573,970 to 135,060.
Mechanical Lloyd's price remained unchanged at 49 cedis.

One trader said the market was picking up after a sluggish showing last week. Others disagreed. Traders have blamed lack of turnover this year on competition from more attractive government bond issues.
Market capitalisation rose to 3,209.76 billion cedis from Friday's 3,208.98 billion cedis. ($1=1,710 cedis)
